# Events index

Every event the Surface contracts emit, grouped by contract. Signatures and field meanings live on the per-contract pages.

## Surface

**[`AdminSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#adminset)** · Emitted when an admin key is granted (`allowed = true`) or revoked.

**[`Approval`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#approval)** · Standard ERC721 single-token approval event.

**[`ApprovalForAll`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#approvalforall)** · Standard ERC721 operator approval event.

**[`BatchMetadataUpdate`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#batchmetadataupdate)** · ERC-4906 range refresh, emitted by `setRenderer` and `setSupplyCap` (all tokens) and by `notifyMetadataUpdate` (a renderer- or admin-chosen range).

**[`Burned`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#burned)** · Emitted when a token is burned.

**[`ContractURIUpdated`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#contracturiupdated)** · ERC-7572 contract-level refresh, emitted by `setRenderer` alongside the token-range refresh.

**[`CreatorListed`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#creatorlisted)** · Emitted when the owner lists or unlists a creator, including each creator seeded at init.

**[`Initialized`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#initialized)** · OpenZeppelin Initializable event, emitted once when the clone is initialized.

**[`MetadataUpdate`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#metadataupdate)** · ERC-4906 single-token refresh, declared for interface completeness; range refreshes use `BatchMetadataUpdate`.

**[`Minted`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#minted)** · Emitted once per mint call.

**[`MinterLocked`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#minterlocked)** · Emitted once when `lockMinter` runs.

**[`MinterSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#minterset)** · Emitted when a minter is granted or revoked, and once per initial minter at init.

**[`OwnershipTransferred`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#ownershiptransferred)** · Standard Ownable event, emitted at init when the first owner is set, when `acceptOwnership` completes a transfer, and when `renounceOwnership` sets the owner to zero.

**[`OwnershipTransferStarted`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#ownershiptransferstarted)** · Standard Ownable2Step event, emitted by `transferOwnership` when a pending owner is recorded.

**[`PrimaryMinterSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#primaryminterset)** · Emitted whenever the frontend-discovery pointer changes: `setPrimaryMinter` on the sequential form, a pooled sole-minter grant or revoke tracking automatically, a revoke of the current primary clearing it to zero on either form, or the value seeded at init.

**[`RendererLocked`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#rendererlocked)** · Emitted once when `lockRenderer` runs, or for a lock set at init.

**[`RendererSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#rendererset)** · Emitted when the renderer pointer changes.

**[`RoyaltySet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#royaltyset)** · Emitted when the royalty changes with `setRoyalty`.

**[`StrayETHRescued`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#strayethrescued)** · Emitted when `rescueStrayETH` sweeps force-fed ETH.

**[`SupplyCapSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#supplycapset)** · Emitted when the supply cap changes with `setSupplyCap`.

**[`SupplyLocked`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#supplylocked)** · Emitted once when `lockSupply` runs, or for a lock set at init.

**[`SurfaceConfigured`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#surfaceconfigured)** · Emitted once at init with the id mode and supply cap.

**[`Transfer`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface#transfer)** · Standard ERC721 transfer event, emitted on mint (from the zero address), transfer, and burn (to the zero address).

## SurfaceFactory

**[`Deprecated`](/docs/surface/contracts/factory#deprecated)** · Emitted once when the deployer deprecates the factory, carrying the successor address (zero if none).

**[`PausedSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/factory#pausedset)** · Emitted when the deployer pauses or resumes new deploys, with the new `paused` state.

**[`SurfaceCreated`](/docs/surface/contracts/factory#surfacecreated)** · Emitted once per successful create call, with `owner` and `collection` indexed.

## FixedPriceMinter

**[`AllowlistRootSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#allowlistrootset)** · Emitted when the allowlist root changes with `setAllowlistRoot`.

**[`Initialized`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#initialized)** · OpenZeppelin Initializable event, emitted once when the clone is initialized.

**[`MaxMintsSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#maxmintsset)** · Emitted when the sale ceiling changes with `setMaxMints`.

**[`MinterConfigured`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#minterconfigured)** · Emitted at `initialize` with the collection binding and the opening sale config.

**[`MintWindowSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#mintwindowset)** · Emitted when the window changes with `setMintWindow`.

**[`PayoutRecipientSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#payoutrecipientset)** · Emitted when the payout address changes with `setPayoutRecipient`.

**[`PriceSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#priceset)** · Emitted when the fixed price changes with `setPrice`.

**[`PriceStrategySet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#pricestrategyset)** · Emitted when the price strategy changes with `setPriceStrategy`.

**[`ReferralPaid`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#referralpaid)** · Emitted when a nonzero referral cut is credited.

**[`ReferralShareSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#referralshareset)** · Emitted when the referral share changes with `setReferralShareBps`.

**[`Sold`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#sold)** · Emitted once per `mint` call.

**[`StrayETHRescued`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#strayethrescued)** · Emitted when `rescueStrayETH` sweeps unowed ETH.

**[`WalletCapSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#walletcapset)** · Emitted when the per-recipient cap changes with `setWalletCap`.

**[`Withdrawn`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-minter#withdrawn)** · Emitted when a pull-payment balance is paid out.

## SurfaceV2

**[`Approval`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#approval)** · Standard ERC721 approval event.

**[`ApprovalForAll`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#approvalforall)** · Standard ERC721 operator approval event.

**[`BatchMetadataUpdate`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#batchmetadataupdate)** · ERC-4906 refresh signal for a token id range; `(0, type(uint256).max)` means every token.

**[`Burned`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#burned)** · A token was burned.

**[`ContractURIUpdated`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#contracturiupdated)** · ERC-7572 signal that `contractURI` output changed.

**[`Initialized`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#initialized)** · Standard OpenZeppelin Initializable event, emitted once by `initialize`.

**[`Minted`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#minted)** · One per `mintTo` call: the calling minter, the recipient, the first id and the quantity.

**[`MinterSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#minterset)** · The minter changed, including at initialize.

**[`NameSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#nameset)** · The name and symbol changed.

**[`OwnershipTransferred`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#ownershiptransferred)** · Standard OpenZeppelin Ownable event, emitted on initialize, transfer and renounce.

**[`RendererSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#rendererset)** · The renderer changed, including at initialize.

**[`RoyaltySet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#royaltyset)** · The royalty changed, including at initialize.

**[`SupplyCapSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#supplycapset)** · The supply cap changed, including at initialize.

**[`Transfer`](/docs/surface/contracts/surface-v2#transfer)** · Standard ERC721 transfer, mint and burn event.

## FixedPriceSale

**[`Closed`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#closed)** · The sale was closed for good.

**[`GateSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#gateset)** · The gate changed, including at initialize.

**[`Initialized`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#initialized)** · Standard OpenZeppelin Initializable event, emitted once by `initialize`.

**[`MaxMintsSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#maxmintsset)** · The ceiling changed, including at initialize.

**[`MintWindowSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#mintwindowset)** · The window changed, including at initialize.

**[`PayoutRecipientSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#payoutrecipientset)** · The payout recipient changed, including at initialize.

**[`PriceSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#priceset)** · The price changed, including at initialize.

**[`ReferralPaid`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#referralpaid)** · A nonzero referral amount accrued to a referrer.

**[`Sold`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#sold)** · One per successful mint: payer, recipient, referrer, quantity, exact payment and first token id.

**[`WalletCapSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#walletcapset)** · The wallet cap changed, including at initialize.

**[`Withdrawn`](/docs/surface/contracts/fixed-price-sale#withdrawn)** · An owed balance was paid out: the account it was owed to, where it went, and the amount.

## AllowlistGate

**[`RootSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/allowlist-gate#rootset)** · A collection's root changed.

## CloneFactory

**[`Created`](/docs/surface/contracts/clone-factory#created)** · One per instance: the implementation, the new instance, and the caller (the launcher, for a launcher-made collection or sale).

**[`Deprecated`](/docs/surface/contracts/clone-factory#deprecated)** · The factory was deprecated, naming a successor.

**[`PausedSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/clone-factory#pausedset)** · The pause flag changed.

## Launcher

**[`DefaultReferrerSet`](/docs/surface/contracts/launcher#defaultreferrerset)** · The default referrer changed, including at construction.

**[`Launched`](/docs/surface/contracts/launcher#launched)** · One per launch: owner, collection and sale.

**[`OwnershipTransferred`](/docs/surface/contracts/launcher#ownershiptransferred)** · Standard OpenZeppelin Ownable event.
